About

Vision, mission & values

The commitments that guide teaching and formation at Champions Academy.

01 / Our Vision

An excellent school of influence producing champions in life. A cutting-edge learning hub for global champions.

02 / Our Mission

To honor God and deliver all His benefits by building a solid foundation for children and equip them with life skills to become champions in life.

Values in our institutional materials

The school’s published core-values graphic names Grace, Commitment to Growth, Leadership Reproduction, Excellence, and Family.

Its homepage also highlights Christ-likeness, Honoring, Integrity, Leadership, and Discipline.
